title: Brock Purdy: Mike Evans's desire to be great brings good pressure for me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brock Purdy: Mike Evans's desire to be great brings good pressure for me
sources.description: Wide receiver Mike Evans joined the 49ers as a free agent this offseason and the relationship he builds with quarterback Brock Purdy is going to be an essential part of the team's offense in 2026.
